C1014.title: Former Huawei Employee Sentenced for Unauthorized Access to Confidential Data via System Bug
keywords: illegally obtaining computer information system data
C1014.summary: A former Huawei employee, identified as Yi, exploited an unrevoked ERP system privilege and a vulnerability in a procurement mini-program after being reassigned. He gained unauthorized access to cable material pricing information and leaked it to a supplier, aiding the supplier in winning bids.
